standard_prerequisites.name: The local splitting of a flat module of finite presentation as a direct summand of a finite free module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 4769-4771) as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of a quasi-coherent module associated to a module over the ring of global sections, and the algebraic description of the determinant of a finite projective module as the annihilator of the module inside its exterior algebra
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4778-4787) as pointers to a lemma of this chapter and to results of another chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the algebraic statement to the sheaf level and identifies the two descriptions of the determinant.

core_obligations: Localise: the statement is local on the space, so the proof assumes the module is a direct summand of a finite free module with complement (proof lines 4769-4772)

Identify the module with an associated sheaf: splitting the module of global sections in the same way shows that the module is the quasi-coherent module associated to its module of global sections, whence its sections over any open are the tensor product of that projective module with the sections of the structure sheaf (proof lines 4773-4781)

Compare the determinants: the algebraic description of the determinant as the annihilator inside the exterior algebra is compatible with the base change to the sections over an open, so the determinant of the module is the annihilator of the module inside its exterior algebra (proof lines 4782-4797)
Conclude: the determinant is therefore the quasi-coherent module associated to an invertible module, hence invertible (proof lines 4795-4798)
proof_roadmap: 问题局部，故可设 F ⊕ G = O_X^{⊕n}（stub 引理）；令 R = O_X(X)，则 F(X) ⊕ G(X) = R^{⊕n}，且对一切开 U 有 F(U) ⊕ G(U) = O_X(U)^{⊕n}。
由此 F = F_M（M = F(X) 为有限投射 R-模），F(U) = M ⊗_R O_X(U)；由 more on algebra 的代数事实，det(M) ⊗_R O_X(U) 正是 F(U) 在外代数中的零化子，故 det(F) = F_{det(M)} 是某个可逆模所对应的层，从而可逆（作者提醒零化子不能通过逐开集取零化子再层化来定义，细节从略）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a flat module of finite presentation the determinant, defined as the annihilator of the module inside its exterior algebra, is an invertible module (author lemma at source lines 4755-4766, label lemma-determinant-as-socle). The proof (source lines 4768-4799) works locally, splits the module off a finite free module, identifies the module and its determinant with the objects associated to the module of global sections, and transfers the algebraic description of the determinant as an annihilator through the base change to the sections over an open, so that the determinant becomes the pullback of an invertible module (proof lines 4769-4798); the author warns that annihilators may not be computed open by open and records that details are omitted. The reduction to the algebraic statement over the ring of global sections is the content. H3.
